# Michał Mleczko — Software Architect & AI Engineer

> Personal portfolio covering business AI implementation, automation, software architecture, BLIK commerce and fast static websites.

## Pages
- [Polish portfolio](https://mleczakm.github.io/)
- [English portfolio](https://mleczakm.github.io/en/)
- [BLIK shops, bookings, rentals and fundraising](https://mleczakm.github.io/platnosci-blik/)
- [BezReszty organizer verification](https://mleczakm.github.io/platnosci-blik/#weryfikacja)

## Focus
- Business AI: process discovery, focused pilots, MCP/API integrations, access controls, human confirmation, team onboarding and ongoing operation.
- Products: conversational commerce and booking, business workflow automation.
- WordPress migration: static public frontend, content and SEO preservation, CDN delivery and lower serving overhead. Performance and actual savings depend on the site and are measured per project.
- Architecture, Go, PHP/Symfony, Python, Docker, CI/CD and cloud infrastructure.

## Selected work
- [SprintSpaces](https://sprintspaces.github.io/): projects, tickets, time tracking, Microsoft 365 integration and optional AI/MCP tools.
- [Ceramiza](https://ceramiza.pl): handmade ceramics, conversational ordering, BLIK payment matching and shipping integration.
- [Warsztatownia Sensoryczna](https://warsztatowniasensoryczna.pl): workshop discovery, bookings, passes, payments and conversational assistant.
- [Cargo rental](https://cargo.mleczki.pl): equipment availability, rental bookings and BLIK payments.
- [BezReszty](https://bezreszty.org.pl): direct-to-organizer BLIK fundraising, automatic bank notification matching, 0% application commission. Semi-automated telephone and mObywatel verification is operator-controlled. Identity, account ownership and BLIK phone association are checked separately. Not automated KYC or a guarantee of fundraiser outcomes.

## Website behavior
The AI workflow is an illustrative demo and does not execute real business operations. The cost calculator uses illustrative, editable monthly costs. Contact enquiries use Formspree. Both language pages contain full static HTML. The original /platnosci-blik/ URL remains unchanged.
